systems.system: service digitalisé de demande de copies d'actes d'état civil
systems.country_label: demande en ligne des copies d'actes d'état civil
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC) jointly with the Ministère de l'Efficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique, through the Agence Togo Digital
systems.tiers: pilot launched 2025-12-19 in five communes: Golfe 1, Agoè-Nyivé 1, Avé 2, Lacs 1 and Zio 2; progressive national deployment intended after evaluation

note: The service launched is for requesting and receiving copies of acts. The ministry calls it a major preparatory step in digitalising the national civil status system, which it does not describe as begun; nothing on how events are recorded.
